essence: Mind-wind dissolved in the inward aim; seeing yet not seeing with steady gaze — this is śāmbhavī mudrā by the guru's grace alone: reality free of void and non-void.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of recognition (pratyabhijñā); the vyabhicāri is wonder (adbhuta), integrated into the śāmbhava state.
